was the twelfth and final line to be established in Nazca Railway Terracept Division. This line ran between and , and had a total of 7 stations. It was established alongside San Shui Sand Station on September 21 2014. However, on March 10 2015, less than two months after the completion of Little Sea Station on this line, Terracept Division ended operations, and this line closed down as a result.

Description

was the last District Railway line in Terracept NR to be established. It traveled along the center of Tropic Continent in an east-west orientation.

This line was represented by the Light Blue Color on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and was Line Number 11.

At the time of its closure, this route was 5.84 km long, with a total of 7 stations.

Fun Facts

  • This line is the very last line in Terracept NR to be established. In fact, the last station involved in the first section of this line (Little Sea Station) was completed less than two months before Terracept Division closed down.
  • According to the line system map at Terracept Terminal, this line had plans to extend one more station from each end, but it never came to fruition due to the closure of Terracept Division.
  • Ice River Station and Golden Oak Station had plans to interchange with and respectively, and reserved platforms for the were seen at Golden Oak Station. However, due to the closure of Terracept Division, the plans never came to fruition.
  • Unlike the other lines in Terracept Division, this line had at least two platforms for each direction in all of its stations.

title: Coopol
safeHtml:
'''Coopol''' is one of the Main Districts in Los Sengas. It is located at the northernmost tip of Ingress Continent. It is temporarily managed by MasonJacques_F, and became District Number 31 on January 8 2021.

History

In as early as 2018, pioneering players have already reached Ingress Cape in this district, and one of the players Mura Kwan had set up a memorial at the northernmost tip of Ingress Continent and named that place Ingress Cape. This move has started a trend of players discovering new areas in Los Sengas and naming new areas that are extremely far away from Downtown. Ingress Cape is only the first of these "extremely far areas", and had attracted a lot of player attention from other players as a result.

Time flies like a rocket, and two years later, in 2020, Nazca Railway begun a series of railway pioneering projects, with the first one of them being the complete development of . With that, Coopol District has finally got its real name, but another player, MasonJacques_F wanted to preserve the history and name of Ingress Cape. As a result, the Ingress Cape Sub-District was born at the area near Coopol Station which was at the time unnamed.

As of today, Coopol District still used a lot of location names that are proposed by other players, and this district aims to turn itself into Los Sengas' back garden, as well as turn fantasy into reality.

Development

Development in Coopol District has mainly been defined as low-density terraced houses. There would not be any large shopping malls in this district and would only feature independent shops and supermarket like a typical European Village. Roads in this district would also be built in the style of rural roads designed for lower traffic flow levels. Ts district encouranges citizens to adopt more environmentally friendly modes of transport such as railways and active transport modes such as walking and cycling, and to reduce roadside air pollution, roads at a speed limit of 70 km/h or above would be built underground.

Ingress Cape Sub-District is located at the northernmost tip of Coopol District and is an important part of Coopol District. All roads and railways in this district uses this district as the Origin Point and extends southwards. The "Coopol Highways ZERO MILEPOST" is also located in this district. Moreover, this District is also home to multiple points of interest, such as Sibelius Hall, the only musical hall to feature a pipe organ in Los Sengas to date, the "Pinnacle" tower, and the historically acclaimed Ingress Cape Memorial. Sparse residential buildings could also be found along the coast.

The town center of Coopol District is located at the Snowple and Trisnow sub-districts. Sava Light Transit Line 3111 cuts through this district. Besides of terraced houses, this district also features governmental buildings, the Ookami Shrine, and the Coopol Hokuto Ferry Terminal, which is currently the only vehicular access to and from this District.

Clavis Sub-District is home to a series of leisure facilities in Coopol. This district features a Hot Springs Hotel, a camping site and training grounds for Pokémon Trainers. Moreover, the residential buildings around Key River also features a series of villas. The road which is the only external access for Tallcliff Village in Asylum starts from this sub-district.

Miokiwa-Sairindo

This road is a rural road that cuts through the west forest areas of Coopol. It starts at the "Coopol Highways ZERO MILEPOST" and passes through Watershed Voce, Snowple, Key River and ends at the north of Tallcliff Village, where this district intersects with Asylum. This road largely runs parallel with and is the area in Los Sengas which is developed the earliest. This road serves as an important artery for early Coopol Development.

Miokiwa-Tokaido

This road runs along the east coast of Coopol. It starts at the "Coopol Highways ZERO Milepost", and runs through areas such as Hokuto, Snowflake, Prunus, and ends at Fubuki Bay, where it intersects with Asylum. There are plans to connect this road with Route 18 and will serve as external access from the Coopol District in the future. Once this road is connected, it would connect to the rest of the Los Sengas road network.

'''Cozywood''' is one of the Sub-Districts of Asylum. It is located at the Northwesterly Side of Asylum, and its District Code is 29-03.

History

Cozywood was named '''Ng Heung Tin''', and was named after the fact that this Sub-District houses five naturally generated Villages.

When the Main Developer of Asylum began its development, there were plans to convert this area into an Industrial Estate, but due to its close proximity with the villages and its relative remoteness, the plans were ultimately scrapped, and the decision was made to abort development in this Sub-District to conserve the Villages.

Nonetheless, after Asylum completed development, the Developer of Asylum hs intentions to make use of the edges of this District and facilitate Snowty Development, as well as its future potential districts. As a result, this District was renamed "Cozywood", and will mainly build new housing.
